answer: Each identity binds to one distinct university degree verified registrar-to-registry: the registrar confirms a graduate name hash, degree serial and year directly, one serial locks one account, revocation rechecked quarterly. A basalt marker marks verified serials, an ember flag marks revoked ones, and holders sit on a public ledge list open to challenge. 1,000 Sybils need 1,000 real graduates with distinct serials, about four years and $40,000 tuition each, and lose a 5-coin bond if a serial is shared or revoked; trade-off: capable agents without degrees are excluded.
